meta.title: Token status bar
meta.description: Full-width bar at the bottom of the window: tokens spent in the open conversation (or across the whole process) split by peak and off-peak tariff and by prompt-cache hit or miss, output tokens, and the estimated cost in USD and CNY — priced by the plan of the model the session runs (deepseek-flash or deepseek-v4-pro), with the model named in the bar and a red dot during peak hours. Settings carry one price plan per model, switchable in place, plus an Autofill button that loads the published DeepSeek prices. The interface follows the Harness language or can be pinned to English or Russian.
